decision.summary: No confirmed temporary offset interval meets full criteria (clear onset, sustained interior, and unambiguous opposing return). The N-component offset (490–530) lacks a confirmed return within allowed context; E/U transients (510–525) are too short and non-plateaued to qualify as independent temporary offsets. All candidate intervals remain uncertain due to ambiguous recovery and superposition with other motion.

intervals.observation: N-component shows a sustained negative offset from index 490, with interior values consistently below pre-onset baseline; E and U show transient multi-sample dips (510–525) that do not fully reverse the N-offset, and no clear opposing return observed in N before index 530.

E and U exhibit correlated multi-sample dips centered ~515–525, but these lack a clear onset edge or sustained interior plateau; the dips are superposed on ongoing N-offset and recover partially within the same window—no definitive return to pre-dip level observed, and axis coherence is incomplete.
